rows.happened: The change touches a path the judge protects.
rows.do: Take that file out; add new tests as new files.

rows.happened: The change edits or deletes a test that already existed.
rows.do: Restore that test; put your own tests in a new file.

rows.happened: The change edits a file that decides how tests run.
rows.do: Restore that file; ask the buyer to change it.

rows.happened: The change touches the terms or the acceptance checks.
rows.do: Take that file out; both were fixed at funding.

rows.happened: The change touches a workflow under `.github/`.
rows.do: Take that file out; ask the buyer to change it.

rows.happened: The change touches a file the run reads from your copy.
rows.do: Take that file out; ask the buyer to change it.

rows.happened: The change edits the scripts of `package.json`.
rows.do: Restore the scripts; ask the buyer to change them.

rows.happened: The change edits a test that already existed.
rows.do: Restore that test; put your own tests in a new file.

rows.happened: The change deletes a test that already existed.
rows.do: Restore that test; put your own tests in a new file.

rows.happened: The issue given to the judge is not an issue number.
rows.do: Run the judge again with the issue's number.

rows.happened: The default branch holds no acceptance checks for this issue.
rows.do: Ask the buyer to restore `.knos/acceptance/<issue>/`.

rows.happened: The repository names a test runner Knos does not have.
rows.do: Ask the buyer to fix `runner` in `.knos/proof.toml`.

rows.happened: The judge's container image could not be pulled or run.
rows.do: Run it again; nothing is held against you.

rows.happened: This machine has no sandbox to run your code in.
rows.do: Run on Linux with setpriv and unshare, or in the workflow.

rows.happened: The sandbox user cannot run this Python.
rows.do: Install knos where every user can reach it.

rows.happened: The test run ended without writing a report.
rows.do: Look for a crash or a timeout, then submit again.

rows.happened: The judge's own passing test did not run and pass.
rows.do: Remove whatever changes which tests are collected.

rows.happened: The judge's own failing test did not fail.
rows.do: Remove whatever makes every test pass.

rows.happened: No acceptance check ran on your change.
rows.do: Make sure your change does not break test collection.

rows.happened: Acceptance checks that ran on the base did not run here.
rows.do: Restore what those checks need to be collected.

rows.happened: Your change does not pass the acceptance checks.
rows.do: Read the named checks, fix the code, submit again.

rows.happened: The acceptance checks already pass without your change.
rows.do: Ask the buyer: the order has nothing left to accept.

rows.happened: Your change collects fewer tests than the base.
rows.do: Restore the tests that no longer run.

rows.happened: A test that passed before your change now fails.
rows.do: Fix the regression the reason names.

rows.happened: The change breaks a rule of the repository's CONTRIBUTING file.
rows.do: Follow the rule and the line the reason names.

rows.happened: The description claims passing checks, and GitHub's record disagrees.
rows.do: Fix the failed check, or correct the description.

rows.happened: This order pays on a merge, not on acceptance checks.
rows.do: Wait for a maintainer to merge.

rows.happened: The acceptance checks on the base are not the funded ones.
rows.do: Ask the buyer to restore them, or to fund again.

rows.happened: A check the order names failed at your last commit.
rows.do: Fix it and push; the newest commit is judged.

rows.happened: A check the order names has not finished.
rows.do: Wait for it to finish, then ask again.

rows.happened: A check the order names was skipped; skipped is not passed.
rows.do: Make that check run on your pull request.

rows.happened: A check the order names did not run on your commit.
rows.do: Push a commit that starts it, or ask a maintainer.

rows.happened: GitHub did not give the result of a named check.
rows.do: Run it again; nothing is held against you.

rows.happened: The change touches a path the order forbids.
rows.do: Take that file out of the change.

rows.happened: The change touches a file outside the order's paths.
rows.do: Keep the change inside the listed paths.

rows.happened: GitHub did not list the changed files.
rows.do: Run it again; nothing is held against you.

rows.happened: Nobody can be named as the account to pay.
rows.do: Comment `/knos mine` on the pull request.

rows.happened: The issue is reserved for, or assigned to, someone else.
rows.do: Wait until the reservation lapses, or ask a maintainer.

rows.happened: A maintainer rejected this pull request for the order.
rows.do: Ask the maintainer, or comment `/knos appeal <reason>`.

rows.happened: The pull request does not close the funded issue.
rows.do: Write `Closes #<issue>` in the description before the merge.

rows.happened: A tip is paid only after the merge.
rows.do: Wait for the merge, then ask again.

rows.happened: GitHub did not give a fact the payment rests on.
rows.do: Run it again; nothing is held against you.

rows.happened: The word after `/knos` is not a command.
rows.do: Comment `/knos help` to list the commands.

rows.happened: The command was not written in its form.
rows.do: Type it the way the reply shows.

rows.happened: This command belongs to someone else.
rows.do: Use the command the reply offers instead.

rows.happened: The command was written in the wrong place.
rows.do: Comment it on the issue or pull request named.

rows.happened: The neutral judge's run was about another order or commit.
rows.do: Start the neutral judge again for this pull request.

rows.happened: The acceptance suite did not pass when the neutral judge ran it.
rows.do: Read its reasons; appeal if they are wrong.

rows.happened: The neutral judge's verdict does not name the two trees judged.
rows.do: Start the neutral judge again.

rows.happened: The neutral judge did not run the suite in the funded image.
rows.do: Start the neutral judge again on a runner with containers.

rows.happened: The neutral judge did not run your code black-box.
rows.do: Start the neutral judge again.

rows.happened: The acceptance checks at the base commit are not the funded ones.
rows.do: Ask the buyer which commit holds the funded checks.

rows.happened: The neutral judge could not run on its machine.
rows.do: Run it again; nothing is held against you.

rows.happened: This run could not decide (insufficient evidence).
rows.do: Run the workflow again; nothing is paid or held against you.

rows.happened: An accepted verdict leaves nothing to appeal.
rows.do: Read `/knos status` for when the money moves.

rows.happened: Only the account that did the work can appeal.
rows.do: Ask the pull request's author to comment it.

rows.happened: The appeal gives no reason.
rows.do: Comment `/knos appeal <reason>` with one sentence.

rows.happened: An appeal of this verdict is open already.
rows.do: Wait for the neutral judge's run to end.

rows.happened: This appeal has ended, and its verdict stands.
rows.do: Open a new pull request to be judged again.

rows.happened: The signing key is not active on chain yet.
rows.do: Try again after its delay and the guardian's approval.

rows.happened: The signing key has expired on chain.
rows.do: Run the rotate workflow, then relay the token again.

rows.happened: The signing key was revoked on chain.
rows.do: Run the workflow again for a token from another key.

rows.happened: An account is wrong, or a signature is missing.
rows.do: Build the instruction again with this client.

rows.happened: An amount, a time, the mode or the terms is outside limits.
rows.do: Change the value to one the limits allow.

rows.happened: This funder already has a job on this issue.
rows.do: Raise or cancel the one that exists.

rows.happened: The job is not in the state this step needs.
rows.do: Comment `/knos status`, then act on what it says.

rows.happened: The signed token is not verified, expired, or not GitHub's.
rows.do: Start a new run for a new token.

rows.happened: The token's claims do not allow this action.
rows.do: Comment again; a re-run of a job never counts.

rows.happened: The token comes from another workflow than the order pinned.
rows.do: Run the workflow the order names.

rows.happened: The token's audience does not match this action.
rows.do: Start a new run for this action.

rows.happened: A destination account is wrong, or the payee has no wallet.
rows.do: Bind a wallet with `knos claim`, then settle again.

rows.happened: This instruction works on a devnet build only.
rows.do: Use devnet.

rows.happened: The faucet serves each repository once a minute.
rows.do: Wait a minute and comment again.

rows.happened: The token is not newer than the last one used.
rows.do: Comment again for a new token.

rows.happened: This comment cannot spend that balance.
rows.do: Ask the balance's wallet to list you as a spender.

rows.happened: The amount is more than the balance allows for one job.
rows.do: Fund less, or ask its wallet to raise the limit.

rows.happened: The balance does not hold that much.
rows.do: Add money to it, or fund less.

rows.happened: This mint cannot be used here.
rows.do: Use a mint that cannot block or tax a transfer.

rows.happened: New funding is paused.
rows.do: Wait; payments, refunds and withdrawals go on.

rows.happened: Only the guardian can pause.
rows.do: Sign with the guardian's key.

rows.happened: The balance exists already, or the signer did not open it.
rows.do: Sign with the wallet that opened it.

rows.happened: A faucet balance cannot be withdrawn.
rows.do: Spend it on test orders.

rows.happened: The balance's limit for a day or in total is reached.
rows.do: Fund less, or ask its wallet to raise the limit.

rows.happened: This order exists already.
rows.do: Fund it under another seq.

rows.happened: Only the fee owner sets a plan.
rows.do: Sign with the fee owner's key.

rows.happened: The order is standing and also has a holdback.
rows.do: Fund a new order with one of the two.

rows.happened: An account in the instruction is wrong.
rows.do: Build the instruction again with this client.

rows.happened: The terms are not what the job was funded with.
rows.do: Send the terms the funding comment recorded.

rows.happened: The job exists already, or the account is another job.
rows.do: Raise or cancel the one that exists.

rows.happened: The job is not in the state or time this needs.
rows.do: Comment `/knos status`, then act on what it says.

rows.happened: The signed token is not verified, expired, or not GitHub's.
rows.do: Start a new run for a new token.

rows.happened: The token's claims do not allow this action.
rows.do: Comment again; a re-run of a job never counts.

rows.happened: The token comes from another workflow than the job pinned.
rows.do: Run the workflow the job names.

rows.happened: The token's audience does not match this action.
rows.do: Start a new run for this action.

rows.happened: The payee's account or the fee account is wrong.
rows.do: Bind a wallet with `knos claim`, then settle again.

rows.happened: This instruction works on devnet only.
rows.do: Use devnet.

rows.happened: A repository is funded once a minute.
rows.do: Wait a minute and comment again.

rows.happened: Nothing is due on this job.
rows.do: Comment `/knos status` to see what was paid.

rows.happened: The token is longer than the verifier takes.
rows.do: Start a new run; shorten the audience if you set it.

rows.happened: The signature is not as long as its key.
rows.do: Start a new run for a new token.

rows.happened: A verifier account is wrong, or another run moved it.
rows.do: Send the token again.

rows.happened: The signing key is not ready on chain.
rows.do: Wait for the key's rotation, then send again.

rows.happened: Another run moved this token's account.
rows.do: Send the token again.

rows.happened: The signature is not the issuer's.
rows.do: Start a new run for a new token.

rows.happened: The token is not signed with RS256.
rows.do: Use an issuer that signs with RS256.

rows.happened: The token's issuer is not the key's issuer.
rows.do: Send the token with its own issuer's key.

rows.happened: The chain does not trust this signing key.
rows.do: Run the rotate workflow, then send again.

rows.happened: The key's attestation is not the rotate workflow's.
rows.do: Run the rotate workflow in the attester's repository.

rows.happened: The key's attestation has expired.
rows.do: Run the rotate workflow again.

rows.happened: The token's claims are not a JSON object.
rows.do: Start a new run for a new token.

rows.happened: A claim the meter reads appears twice in the token.
rows.do: Use an issuer that writes each claim once.

rows.happened: A claim the meter reads is missing from the token.
rows.do: Run the workflow the credits pin.

rows.happened: The signing key is not active on chain yet.
rows.do: Try again after its delay and the guardian's approval.

rows.happened: The signing key has expired on chain.
rows.do: Run the rotate workflow, then relay the token again.

rows.happened: The signing key was revoked on chain.
rows.do: Run the workflow again for a token from another key.

rows.happened: An account is wrong, or a signature is missing.
rows.do: Build the instruction again with this client.

rows.happened: The owner, the commit, the rate or the tier is outside limits.
rows.do: Change the value to one the limits allow.

rows.happened: This is not a credits account the signer opened.
rows.do: Sign with the wallet that opened the credits.

rows.happened: The signed token is not verified, expired, or not GitHub's.
rows.do: Start a new run for a new token.

rows.happened: The token is from a re-run, or another kind of runner.
rows.do: Start a new run on GitHub's own runner.

rows.happened: The token is not from the workflow commit the credits pin.
rows.do: Open the credits again to pin this commit.

rows.happened: The token's audience is not an evaluation's.
rows.do: Run the workflow with kind `eval`.

rows.happened: The run was not in a repository of the named buyer.
rows.do: Run it in a repository the buyer owns.

rows.happened: The credits do not hold that much.
rows.do: Add money to the credits, then send this again.

rows.happened: This mint cannot be used for credits.
rows.do: Use Circle's USDC.

rows.happened: The fee account or the destination account is wrong.
rows.do: Build the instruction again with this client.

rows.happened: Only the fee owner sets a plan.
rows.do: Sign with the fee owner's key.

rows.happened: The meter does not count tokens signed by this kind of key.
rows.do: Use a key of a public issuer.

rows.happened: This mark cannot be closed by this signer.
rows.do: Sign with the wallet the mark names.

rows.happened: This mark cannot be closed yet.
rows.do: Send this again after the time the mark names.

rows.happened: This batch is not the ledger's next one.
rows.do: Read `next_seq` from the ledger and send that batch.

rows.happened: The batch's counts are outside what a batch may hold.
rows.do: Send 1 to 100,000 evaluations for this month or the last.

rows.happened: An account in the instruction is wrong.
rows.do: Build the instruction again with this client.

rows.happened: That is not a compressed P-256 public key.
rows.do: Give the 33 bytes the passkey reported.

rows.happened: That account is not a passkey wallet.
rows.do: Open the wallet first.

rows.happened: The passkey's signature check is not right before the withdrawal.
rows.do: Build both instructions with this client.

rows.happened: The signature is another passkey's.
rows.do: Sign with the passkey that opened this wallet.

rows.happened: The signed message is not what the passkey signed.
rows.do: Sign again and send what the device returned.

rows.happened: The device did not report that a person was present.
rows.do: Sign again and confirm on the device.

rows.happened: The client data is not a passkey signature's.
rows.do: Sign again with the page's own request.

rows.happened: The passkey signed for another withdrawal or funding.
rows.do: Sign again for this one.

rows.happened: The nonce is not the wallet's next one.
rows.do: Read the wallet and sign again.

rows.happened: This mint cannot be withdrawn.
rows.do: Use a mint the program accepts.

rows.happened: The signature's s is in the upper half.
rows.do: Send n minus s, as this client's builders do.

rows.happened: The source is not this wallet's token account.
rows.do: Name the wallet's own account of this mint.

rows.happened: The slot is past the expiry the passkey signed for.
rows.do: Sign again.

rows.happened: The funding instruction is not this deployment's.
rows.do: Build the funding with this client.

rows.happened: Knos has no plain words for this refusal yet.
rows.do: Open an issue on Knos and quote the reason.
